Speed pass (2026-11-05): an image cache prepared at build time (pages 36-43, each image in its commonest ink, OUTINB; profile cache_inks), every hook at 28 MHz restoring the caller's speed (latches), a pace limiter on the attribute hooks (JNext's mean original durations); pace -1.4 to -1.7 % (the body copy runs from uncontended RAM). games/cauldron.md. Round 2 (2026-11-05): the one-frame vanish (23 in 900 JNext frames) was the gap between an erase's hide and the next draw's show, swept by the beam (23 of 23); fixed by pending hides committed in one beam-timed burst (0 in 900); plot-hook limiter (hlib_pace, the original's JNext time x 0.95): pace quiet -0.45 %, busy +0.47 %, sound +0.49 % (10 trials each).
